files.note: High oblique aerial (from a plane) into the empty bowl, taken just before the stadium opened, football lines painted. Field centred horizontally (x ~460-940) and in rows ~370-640 of 1000; a 16:9 crop of rows ~210-1000 puts the field at ~20-55%. Only 1400 px wide (below the 1600 px floor) but it is the only day bowl view on Commons that is not soccer or a railing shot; the same flight's 3840x2160 original (PXL 20220826 184856422.jpg) has the stadium too small to crop larger.
